fields.label: Slug
fields.description: URL-safe identifier — flamezo.in/c/<slug>. Auto-generated from display_name. Immutable from the creator side (slug stability = link stability). Ops can rename via direct DB write.

fields.label: Visibility
fields.description: public = indexed, in directory. unlisted = /c/<slug> works, not in directory. private = 404 for everyone.

fields.label: Headline
fields.description: Creator's own short bio headline — the one text field they control. Max 200 chars.

fields.label: Featured Posts (JSON)
fields.description: [{"type": "native_chills", "id": "CH-00001"}, ...] — up to 6. Creator-curated; view counts are pulled live, never stored here.

fields.label: Report Count
fields.description: Incremented by report_portfolio (allow_guest). Manual review triggered at threshold.
